summary: Implemented typed primitive geometry support for Box, Sphere, and Cylinder, including public models, scene-precedence helpers, and typed execution IR with bounds and transform metadata.
key_findings: Added `Box`, `Sphere`, `Cylinder`, and `GeometryTransform` public models in `src/autofdtd/geometry/primitives.py` with validation, bounds, containment, and translation helpers.
Extended scene semantics so `Structure` exposes bounds/containment and `Scene.resolve_structure_at_point()` mirrors priority-ordered materialization for overlap resolution.

Lowered supported primitive geometries into typed IR nodes (`BoxIR`, `SphereIR`, `CylinderIR`) carrying explicit bounds and scene-compilation transform metadata instead of only generic component envelopes.
Updated validation to handle typed primitive geometry models alongside tagged dict payloads, preserving existing normalization behavior.
Added coverage for primitive geometry APIs, precedence resolution, typed IR lowering, bundle serialization, and repo-wide imports; `pytest -q` passes with 28 tests.

artifacts.description: Typed primitive geometry public models and scene-compilation transform helpers.
Structure and Scene helpers for geometry bounds, point containment, and precedence resolution.
Primitive geometry validation, bounds, and containment integration for typed models and tagged mappings.
Typed primitive geometry IR models and lowering helpers.
Container and primitive geometry behavior tests, including precedence resolution.
Execution IR tests covering typed primitive geometry lowering and bundle serialization.
Updated distilled task handoff notes for primitive geometry and transform contracts.

follow_up_notes: Next geometry tasks can build `Transformed`, `GeometryGroup`, and array lowering on top of the new `GeometryTransform` and typed primitive IR contracts instead of introducing a separate primitive-geometry path.
